verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents global transfers to suppliers, employees, contractors and own accounts, including batch transfers across countries and currencies, so sending money abroad is covered. Nothing in the pack makes any claim about settlement speed, so the defining 'arrives in under a minute' part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any documented delivery-time or instant-settlement guarantee for cross-border transfers, corridor or rail coverage for real-time payouts, and independent or hands-on confirmation of speed.
